level: mixed: park-level rows end with "park", point rows end with "point"
camps: Campgrounds: Fishermen's Memorial Campground. Sites: 182 sites listed on official reservation page: tent, standard, and RV-only; electric and full-hookup options are listed for some sites. Open: Season schedule shown on reservation page through October 30, 2026. Location: park street address (1011 Point Judith Road, Narragansett, RI 02882), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: George Washington Campground. Sites: 45 gravel sites for tents, trailers and RVs; no electrical hookups; shared water spigots; pit toilets/outhouses; no showers. Cabins / lodging: Two Adirondack-style group shelters available by reservation. Open: Season schedule shown on reservation page through October 30, 2026. Location: park street address (2185 Putnam Pike, Chepachet, RI), placed by the US Census geocoder
Campgrounds: Charlestown Breachway Campground. Sites: 75 sites for self-contained RVs; no tents or pop-ups
